title: Mathematical Models in Biology (TUM, Modul MA3601)
titleEn: Mathematical Models in Biology (TUM, Module MA3601)
description: After successful completion of the module, the student is able to evaluate the connection of different results related to different model approaches (stochastic/deterministic, discrete/continuous) and to choose the appropriate level for the description of the system under observation. Furthermore they are able to formulate mathematical models for biological systems on the basis of analytic, stochastic or discrete mathematical structures. 9 ECTS, angeboten im Wintersemester, Version 2023s.
